profile.note: Confirmed PvE on 2026-08-10; see the Fence batch, whose [PVE ZONE] cards carry ids that exist only in tarkov.dev's pve task list.
profile.factionNote: USEC. DETERMINED FROM THE COLLECTION ITSELF, not something written down at capture time. Four quests are faction-exclusive with no counterpart id: Road Closed (USEC), Green Corridor (BEAR), Our Own Land (BEAR) and Counteraction (USEC). "Road Closed" is ACTIVE on this profile, and the wiki says outright that it is "only obtainable by USEC PMCs" with Green Corridor as its BEAR counterpart. Both BEAR-only quests are absent from Prapor's list, which was captured in full. A BEAR profile could not show Road Closed and would have to show the other two, so the reading is unambiguous.

reading: Read off the in-game quest screen. Objective text is verbatim, including the (Optional) prefix.
allVisibleCapturedMeaning: true = every quest VISIBLE to this profile was captured, completed, active, failed, or listed-but-locked, across every tab the trader shows. It does NOT mean every quest the trader has: anything still gated behind an unfinished quest or an unreached loyalty level is not on screen and is therefore not here. No trader in this collection is complete in the absolute sense.
allVisibleCapturedNote: NOT complete, deliberately. LL1-LL3 and the essential group were all sent, but I have not reached Ragman LL4, the Collector unlock panel shows Ragman as one of two traders still short of LL4. Marking this complete would produce a straggler list accusing the sources of publishing quests that are simply not unlocked yet. It also means the two faction variants of 'Textile - Part 1', two of the three loyalty gates tarkov.dev publishes and the only ones left untested. CANNOT be settled from this profile until Ragman LL4 is reached.

quests.name: Drip-Out - Part 1
quests.openQuestion: FACTION VARIANT, MATCHED ARBITRARILY. Sources publish this twice, once for BEAR and once for USEC, under the same name, and the two records are identical in every field except the id and factionName (same objectives, same minimum level). The screenshots do not show the profile's PMC faction, so the matcher takes whichever id it meets first. That costs nothing for grading, because the content is the same either way, but a correction layer keyed BY ID would be attaching its fix to a coin flip. Applies to Drip-Out Parts 1 and 2 and both Textile lines. Resolvable with one look at the profile's faction.
objectives: Eliminate Raiders (100)
Hand over the found in raid WARTECH brand equipment (50)
quests.questIdReason: FACTION VARIANT, now pinned rather than guessed. Every source publishes this twice under one name, BEAR and USEC, identical in every field but the id, so content cannot choose and the matcher was taking whichever it met first. This profile is USEC (see profile.factionNote), so the USEC id is the right one. Grading was never affected, because the twins agree; a correction layer keyed BY ID was.
